statusDetail: Coverage-complete audit of five representative public paths. Edge rate limiting intermittently produced 403s during parallel evidence collection; claims use successful captures or identify the reproducible user-facing 403 route explicitly.

Primary identity-registration method chooser and responsive component archetype.
Credential recovery entry and recovery-state archetype.

findings.summary: The interface does not adapt to dark or higher-contrast preferences.
findings.evidence: The dark-mode and prefers-contrast screenshots retain the same hard-coded white/grey/yellow palette; the DOM reports color-scheme: normal, and Lighthouse also found 3.73:1 footer contrast.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and use prefers-color-scheme/light-dark() tokens; add tested high-contrast/forced-colors styles for text, controls and icons.

findings.summary: Page and state changes are abrupt and use no modern transition mechanism.
findings.evidence: Raw HTML/CSS feature search found no view-transition signal, while the primary registration, sign-in and recovery actions navigate between separate documents.
findings.suggestedFix: Add opt-in cross-document View Transitions with a reduced-motion fallback for related public journeys.

findings.summary: Fixed cookie and chat UI obscures primary content, especially on mobile.
findings.evidence: Mobile screenshots show the cookie strip and chat launcher covering registration choices and form controls; the desktop screenshot shows the chat prompt covering the sign-in card.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the redundant technical-cookie banner or make it compact and dismissible; defer chat until requested and reserve non-overlapping space.

findings.summary: Overlay UI is implemented as unlabeled custom dialog divs.
findings.evidence: The DOM probe found seven [role=dialog]/dialog nodes, all custom DIV dialogs without aria-label; the assistance action is an href="javascript:void(0)" trigger.
findings.suggestedFix: Use native dialog/popover primitives, label each surface, provide declarative light-dismiss, restore focus, and use a button for actions.

findings.summary: Several mobile templates reflow poorly even without horizontal scrolling.
findings.evidence: At 360px the registration options are squeezed into three narrow columns, broken-image fallback text collides with content, and the suspension form is covered by persistent chrome.
findings.suggestedFix: Recompose the option cards into a one-column/sensible grid at narrow container sizes and test each component with container queries.

findings.summary: The public landing page has slow paint and inefficient delivery.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 6.9s and FCP 5.2s, with 94 requests/962 KiB; it estimated 3.1s render-blocking savings, 665 KiB cache savings and flagged modern HTTP/font delivery issues.
findings.suggestedFix: Shorten the critical dependency chain, set durable cache policy for versioned assets, preload only the LCP-critical asset, use font-display, and modernize HTTP delivery.

findings.summary: The page ships substantial unused, legacy and unminified client code.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 105 KiB unused JS, 77 KiB unused CSS, 28 KiB minifiable JS, 13 KiB minifiable CSS and 22 KiB legacy-JS savings; diagnostics counted 41 scripts and 20 stylesheets.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove unused bundles, split conditional assistance/analytics code, deduplicate styles and serve modern minified builds.

findings.summary: Core semantics and accessible names are incomplete.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse accessibility scored 0.71, found no main landmark and seven images without alt attributes; the page probe also shows empty headings and unlabeled dialogs.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a single main landmark, remove empty headings, label every dialog/control, and give meaningful images alt text or decorative images alt="".

findings.summary: Keyboard order and zoom are overridden.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found positive tabindex values from 2 through 39 on major links and a viewport declaration containing user-scalable=no/user-scalable=0.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove positive tabindex values and rely on DOM order; remove user-scalable restrictions so browser zoom remains available.

findings.summary: Some text and controls are hard to perceive or read.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found 3.73:1 footer contrast and links distinguished by color alone; mobile registration text is cramped into narrow columns while overlays cover adjacent content.
findings.suggestedFix: Use AA-compliant tokens, non-color link cues, and comfortable line lengths/spacing; stack dense card content on narrow screens.

findings.summary: The page loads with network console errors and fragile image markup.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse recorded 404s for /federation/openid/acrlevel and /favicon.ico; the images primitive found all 18 images lack explicit dimensions, 13 lack alt, seven below-fold images are not lazy, and all are legacy formats.
findings.suggestedFix: Fix the failed endpoints, provide a favicon, add image dimensions, lazy-load below-fold images and modernize suitable assets.

findings.summary: Public pages lack basic descriptive and share metadata.
findings.evidence: The page has a title but no meta description, canonical, Open Graph tags, hreflang or JSON-LD; Lighthouse SEO scored 0.73.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a unique description and canonical URL, then provide accurate Open Graph and Organization/WebSite structured metadata for the public landing page.

findings.summary: Indexing signals are incomplete and one action is not crawlable.
findings.evidence: robots.txt and sitemap.xml both returned HTTP 404 application error pages; no canonical is present, and the assistance link uses javascript:void(0).
findings.suggestedFix: Publish valid robots.txt and sitemap.xml, add canonical links, and replace pseudo-links with buttons or real href destinations.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced security policy is incomplete and one routing cookie is weak.
findings.evidence: The successful 200 response has HSTS, nosniff and SAMEORIGIN but no CSP, Referrer-Policy or Permissions-Policy; BACKEND is set without Secure, HttpOnly or SameSite.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a nonce/hash-based CSP with frame-ancestors, a strict Referrer-Policy and minimal Permissions-Policy; harden or remove the BACKEND cookie.

findings.summary: The stated technical-cookie-only posture conflicts with active third-party tracking.
findings.evidence: The visible banner says only technical cookies are used, yet Lighthouse found five third-party cookies and the tracker capture contacted seven third-party origins including Adobe/Demdex/Everest endpoints.
findings.suggestedFix: Align the claim and behavior: remove nonessential tracking by default or obtain valid, granular consent before loading it; minimize and batch analytics.

findings.summary: The public authentication proposition appears password-only.
findings.evidence: The landing page offers username/password recovery and the captured HTML contains no WebAuthn/passkey feature signal on the public auth entry surface.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkeys/WebAuthn alongside account recovery, with clear registration, authentication, reauthentication and management flows.

findings.summary: A prominently linked accessibility route returns a bare 403 page.
findings.evidence: Opening “Versione accessibile” produced a browser-rendered 403 Forbidden page with no site navigation or recovery path.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve the route reliably or remove the dead alternative; make the primary experience accessible and provide a useful branded 4xx recovery state.

findings.summary: Sensitive account forms omit input assistance and accessible validation hooks.
findings.evidence: Raw suspension and recovery markup contains unlabeled-by-attribute inputs without autocomplete, required, aria-invalid or aria-live signals; the suspension form handles username and secret suspension codes.
findings.suggestedFix: Add correct autocomplete tokens, explicit labels/required semantics, and validate after interaction with synchronized :user-invalid, aria-invalid and announced error summaries.

findings.summary: Asset and third-party budgets are disproportionate for a mostly static landing page.
findings.evidence: The page transfers 962 KiB across 94 requests; all 18 images use PNG/GIF, seven below-fold images are eager, and seven third-party origins are contacted.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a page-weight/third-party budget, defer chat and analytics, lazy-load below-fold imagery, and use appropriately sized modern image formats.
